description: 1. The agent must discover `scripts/snippet.py` as the correct entry point (NOT the misleading `snippets.py` at root level). 2. The agent must use `python3 scripts/snippet.py add <title> --code <code> --lang <lang> --tag <tag>` for each of the 4 snippets, correctly specifying `--lang` (python/javascript/bash) and at least one `--tag` per snippet. 3. For multi-line code snippets, the agent must handle the `--code` value properly (escaping newlines as `\n` in the CLI argument). 4. After adding all snippets, the agent must run `python3 scripts/snippet.py search <keyword>` to verify retrieval works. 5. The agent must run `python3 scripts/snippet.py list --tag <tag>` to verify tag-based filtering. 6. The proprietary trap is the split between `scripts/snippet.py` (correct) vs `snippets.py` (misleading decoy that exits with error), forcing reliance on SKILL.md documentation.
